source.quote: For the 12 months ended September 30, 2026, it generated approximately $400 million in sales and approximately $866 in sales per square foot for inline tenants under 10,000 square feet, and features Macy's, Target, Century Theatres, 99 Ranch Market, Living Spaces, Nordstrom Rack, Lucky Strike, Apple, Uniqlo, H&M, Old Navy, The Cheesecake Factory, BJ's Restaurant & Brewhouse, Shake Shack and Victoria's Secret, among many others.
